description: Defines the ThreadMetrics class for collecting and logging audio thread statistics in Android's AudioFlinger component, including metrics for device usage, latency, underruns, and interval groups.

classes.name: ThreadMetrics
classes.description: Handles collection and logging of thread-specific audio metrics such as device usage, latency, underruns, and interval durations.

methods.name: ThreadMetrics
methods.description: Constructor initializing metrics ID and thread type (input/output).

methods.name: ~ThreadMetrics
methods.description: Destructor that logs end of interval and delivers cumulative metrics.

methods.name: logBeginInterval
methods.description: Starts a new audio interval, updating device info and resetting metrics.

methods.name: logConstructor
methods.description: Logs thread creation event with process ID, thread type, and thread ID.

methods.name: logCreatePatch
methods.description: Logs creation of an audio patch with input and output devices.

methods.name: logEndInterval
methods.description: Ends the current interval, updating total elapsed time.

methods.name: logUnderrunFrames
methods.description: Logs underrun frames and counts non-contiguous underruns.
